criteria.requirement: Preserve original requirements and completed history; amend only affected facts.
criteria.pass_when: Original sources remain readable and completed movement work remains historical; obstacle work is pending.
criteria.fail_when: Replacing the original request or reopening completed stages loses traceability.

criteria.requirement: Explain behavior and consequential design choices using existing code.
criteria.pass_when: Reuses pose/command model and explains membership lookup and failure-state ownership with a blocked-move example.
criteria.fail_when: Invents a new navigation framework or omits unchanged pose, making the change unsafe or unnecessarily broad.

criteria.requirement: Plan coherent outcomes, dependencies and meaningful acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: A future implementer can verify blocking, later commands and existing turns; boundaries explain why work is grouped.
criteria.fail_when: A function/test census or duplicated execution narration obscures outcomes, or no acceptance catches state mutation.

criteria.requirement: Keep design/planning distinct from implementation and review acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: Changes documents only and distinguishes observed baseline checks from proposed verification and pending review.
criteria.fail_when: Implements the feature or asserts unperformed checks/reviews, misrepresenting readiness.
